narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Fourteen is even, so this grid can be tiled!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>An even count is needed, but it may not be enough.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Let us count the colours that are left.

<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Remove the bottom middle square instead, and count the colours that are left.
